title: The four Rexx/SQL 2.6B3 patches and why each exists
summary: 0001 configure: ooRexx 5 has no oorexx-config and the check accepted only major 4, so the build fell back to the 1990s Object REXX branch and failed; multiarch library dirs were not searched; a fallback search tested the include dir. 0002: GCC 14 errors (VOID, MTMalloc long vs size_t, exit handler LONG vs int). 0003 SQLite driver: stack overflow on long column names aborted the interpreter; strlen() cut text at NUL; BLOBs came back empty; unbounded sprintf into error buffers. 0004: only a leading SELECT was treated as a query, so WITH, PRAGMA, EXPLAIN, VALUES and RETURNING failed; SQLEXECUTE now runs such statements to completion.
invariants: Mark's samples/tester.cmd output is identical before and after the patches.
Every defect has a before/after log in evidence/ (defects_*.log, sqlexecute_before_after.log, test_rexxsql_driver_*.log).
Not changed and still true: SQL text stops at a NUL byte (send such values with executeBound); an empty bound string is stored as NULL (NULLSTRINGIN); no BLOB bind type.

provenance.claim: Unpatched build aborts on a long column name.
